name: week
title: Board week
subtitle: Fictional demonstration business. Planned meetings and outstanding follow-up.

sections.title: Overdue actions
sections.sql: select code,name,board,owner,due_on,days_overdue from action_register where days_overdue>0 order by days_overdue desc

sections.title: Records requiring attention
sections.sql: select * from attention order by due nulls first,code

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by rule,code
sections.note: Evidence checks, not a certification of legal compliance.

sections.title: Meetings and minutes
sections.sql: select code,name,board,held_on,minute_version,signed_on,first_recorded_on,retention_until from meeting_register where state='held' order by held_on
